title: Birdseye's quick-freezing process
summary: After watching Inuit freeze fish in bitter cold in Labrador, Clarence Birdseye developed a commercial quick-freezing process in 1924 and patented a multiplate freezing machine in 1927.
why: He is widely considered the founder of the modern frozen food industry.

notes.problem: A 1925 patent is not in the source; source gives the 1924 process and the 1927 multiplate patent.
